comparison.objective: Slides two drawer boxes into upper and lower rails and closes them flush; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part rail alignment and sequential insertion differ from recessed mandrel stabilization, impact regulation, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Both drawers must close flush; setup and detailed scoring are missing. Candidate requires four physical fractures, four contained fragments, and intact retained inserts and shell.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment/insertion primitives are generic; drawer assembly does not test localized fracture or loose-fragment containment.
